text: emily: Hey team — running linkcheck locally and hitting failures after the last image legend change, seems like the generated anchor for the image caption is colliding with a nearby heading. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/dev/7890 :sadpanda: jordan: Ugh. Can you paste the MDX snippet that triggers it? I remember we had weird slugify rules around colons and parentheses. emily: Sure — here's the file snippet (truncated): emily: ```mdx ### Serve flow ``` jordan: I can repro with that. The caption slug becomes `serve-flow-hosted-dedicated` while the H3 slug is `serve-flow` and linkcheck's fragment resolver is trying fuzzy matches, then treats them as duplicates in the same page. rahul: Quick options: 1) change caption text to avoid duplicating the heading; 2) add an explicit id on the heading (`### Serve flow {#serve-flow}`) or on the figure; 3) tweak linkcheck config to prefer heading ids over generated caption anchors. emily: I want to avoid content churn, so I'd prefer adding explicit ids. If we add `{#serve-flow}` to the heading, will that be stable across mkdocs/docusaurus? jordan: Both MkDocs and Docusaurus respect explicit header IDs in MDX/markdown. Adding the explicit id should short-circuit the fuzzy match. emily: OK I'll open a tiny PR that adds explicit ids to the few pages flagged by linkcheck and include a unit test for the fragment resolver. Creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 docs-bot: buildkite:build #docs-linkcheck failed — 5 broken fragments detected on staging (see job 4567). rahul: For follow-up, can we also add a linter rule in our docs pipeline that complains when an image caption slug would conflict with a heading on the same page? I can sketch a rule that compares generated slugs in the AST pass. jordan: +1. If we add that, linkcheck failures become actionable during authoring. Happy to review a PR. emily: PR opened and small patch applied to 4 files. Running local linkcheck again, looks green. I'll leave the PR description with the repro and a note to follow up with a linter task. rahul: Nice. Tag me on the linter issue and I’ll prototype it next week. :thumbsup: emily: Thanks all — merging once CI turns green. jordan: Thanks emily, and thanks rahul for the linter idea. docs-bot: buildkite:build #docs-linkcheck passed on PR 1287 (staging). :party:
